FN-ZLVCRKW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 191
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 191 as introduced would authorize the Alcoholic Beverage Control Board to acquire
and hold real property for the purpose of owning and operating warehouse, or warehouses,
which would increase the financial obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the difference in (1) total costs to acquire and hold real property or properties
and other associated costs; and (2) current rental obligations for existing facilities. Per the
Board, the amount paid in rental expenses for existing warehouses in fiscal year 2023 was
$835,426.
